faq.q: Is mortgage escrow the same as a buyer deposit?
faq.a: No. This guide concerns the mortgage-servicer account for property-related charges, not a deposit or payment requirement under a Cash As-Is purchase agreement.

faq.q: Will I always receive a separate escrow refund check after selling?
faq.a: No. Ask how the remaining funds were handled. Escrow may already have been netted into the payoff, or another permitted treatment may apply.

faq.q: Does the 20-day federal rule mean 20 calendar days after signing?
faq.a: No. The rule addresses full mortgage payment and excludes Saturdays, Sundays and legal public holidays. Confirm coverage and account treatment with the servicer.

faq.q: Should I count an expected refund as cash available on moving day?
faq.a: Use confirmed available funds for immediate expenses. A projected later refund is not the same as money already received, and the final reconciliation can change the amount.

substantiveDifference: Mortgage servicer escrow reconciliation and cash availability after payoff, not tax allocation between buyer/seller, recorded lien release or a generic net-proceeds comparison.
